# BackTable

> > BackTable is a podcast-based medical education platform connecting physicians across specialties with expert-led clinical discussions and real-world case insights.

BackTable provides specialized continuing education through physician-hosted podcasts covering cardiology, urology, OBGYN, ENT, oncology, musculoskeletal medicine, and healthcare industry topics. The platform combines clinical expertise from leading physicians with accessible learning formats for healthcare professionals seeking peer-driven education and professional development.

## Key Topics

- Medical Education
- Clinical Insights
- Physician Interviews
- Continuing Education
- Podcast Platform
- Cardiology
- Urology
- OBGYN
- ENT & Allergy
- Tumor Board

- Healthcare Industry
- Specialty Shows
- Physician Learning
- Medical Podcast

## Specialty Podcasts

- [BackTable Cardiology Podcast](https://www.backtable.com/shows/cardiology): BackTable Cardiology Podcast for cardiologists and cardiovascular specialists
- [BackTable Urology Podcast](https://www.backtable.com/shows/urology): BackTable Urology Podcast for urologists and urologic oncologists
- [BackTable OBGYN Podcast](https://www.backtable.com/shows/obgyn): BackTable OBGYN Podcast for gynecologists and women's health specialists
- [BackTable ENT & Allergy Podcast](https://www.backtable.com/shows/ent): BackTable ENT & Allergy Podcast for otolaryngologists and allergists
- [BackTable Tumor Board Podcast](https://www.backtable.com/shows/tumor-board): BackTable Tumor Board Podcast for oncologists treating cancer patients
- [BackTable Musculoskeletal Podcast](https://www.backtable.com/shows/msk): BackTable Musculoskeletal Podcast for radiologists, pain specialists, surgeons

## Healthcare Leadership & Industry

- [BackTable Industry Podcast: How is Healthcare Changing?](https://www.backtable.com/shows/industry): BackTable Industry Podcast for healthcare leaders and business-minded providers
- [Doctors & Litigation: The L Word Podcast](https://www.backtable.com/shows/doctors-and-litigation): BackTable podcast for physicians navigating medical malpractice lawsuits
- [BackTable for Business](https://business.backtable.com): BackTable B2B partnership platform for healthcare education and sponsorships
